correctness.rationale: There are only ranks 0,1,2 for square-zero factors in dimension four. Counting image/kernel flags and isomorphisms gives the stated N_1 and N_2 with N_2/N_1=q(q−1). At rank one, B preserves the image line of A and vanishes on it, so every product is zero. In the E_12 basis the commuting square-zero B parameters give q(q³+q²−q) partners with zero 2×2 block and q(q²−1)q² with a nonzero square-zero block. At rank two, the centralizer is M_2(k[t]/t²), A=t, B=P+tQ, and the equations are P²=0 and PQ+QP=0. For P=0 there are q⁴ possibilities and zero product; for nonzero P=E_12 up to conjugacy, Q_21=0 and Q_11+Q_22=0 are independent even in characteristic two, giving q² choices. There are q²−1 such P, and tP has rank one. Uniform conjugacy on the N_1 nonzero targets gives N_2 q²(q²−1)/N_1=q³(q−1)(q²−1). Adding the rank-zero and rank-one cases and the rank-two zero partners yields the stated zero fiber, equivalently 1+N_1+N_2+N_1(q⁵+q⁴−q²)+N_2q⁴. No nonzero target of a different type can occur. All arguments count ordered labeled pairs over an arbitrary finite field.
